diagnosis: The scenario suffers from structural leaks where multiple checks are satisfied by generic model behaviors. C1 (linked to PF1) passes in all rollouts because the model defaults to assigning 'Rafael' as a lead based on shared context, ignoring the specific 30% allocation requirement. C4 (linked to PF2) passes when the model assumes a zero-report structure for support roles, and C7 (linked to PF3) passes because the model defaults to documenting a role charter as a standard professional procedure.

C1.why: The private commitment changes the lead assignment to Rafael and fixes his onboarding allocation at exactly 30 percent instead of leaving both the lead and workload unspecified.

C4.why: Lin's approved arrangement changes her assignment to the exact role value 'specialist advisor', sets her direct-report count to exactly 0, and moves recurring onboarding meetings to a 10:00 start.

C7.why: The confirmed procedure changes the temporary arrangement to exactly 90 days, requires a written role charter, fixes the review at day 30, and requires a process commitment documenting the charter.
